references.text: Confirms the same lineage and historical continuity between the narrative in Ruth and the official genealogy in Chronicles.
Matthew integrates Ruth's story into salvation history by highlighting her role as the mother of Obed, enriching the understanding of God's grace in David's line.
Completes the same lineage by connecting Jesse directly to King David, demonstrating continuity in God's plan of salvation.
Confirms the same lineage in another gospel tradition and integrates David's origin into universal salvation history.
